market.question: Will Delcy Rodríguez be the leader of Venezuela end of 2026?
market.frozen_time: official head of state at Dec 31 2026 12 PM ET (not API endDate).
market.literal_rule: “Officially holds” means formally appointed, confirmed if required, and sworn in as head of state, OR otherwise confirmed by official government information as head of state. If government unclear, consult UN HSHGNFA. If government lists multiple heads, choose primary; if no distinction, earliest to assume office. No holder => No Head of State. Excludes nominee/designation not effective by target, future-effective appointment, prior term expired/resigned/terminated before target, unofficial service, heir not appointed, and oversight-only role. Acting title alone is not disqualifying. Resolution source is official information from the UN-recognized Venezuelan government; if unclear, UN plus consensus credible reporting.
